title: An informative and enjoyable Seville cathedral tour
text: Our guide Adriana was excellent. She was welll-informed and prepared. We learned things from her about Seville Cathedral that were not in any guide book. She was also sensitive to our needs. One of the group had mobility issues and required frequent stops to sit which Ariadna fit seamlessly into our tour, continuing narration when we had to stop.  We highly recommend the experience.
author: cwgcanno

title: A must for Seville.
text: If you’re in Seville you must book a tour with Antonio. We had him for a private tour of the Alcazar, La Giralda, plaza de Espana and points in between. So much history, and how it relates to today. He is articulate, engaging, funny, and patient; answering all of our questions about thoroughly and with great insight.  You will begin the tour with a guide, but depart as friends.
author: Jenrainey
